description.en: Ends a talk interaction started with CMND_TALK_START, releasing the NPC handle back to its normal behavior.
Handle of the NPC that was talked to.
True once the talk interaction ended; null if the call was invalid (no handle given) or the handle doesn't resolve to an existing character.

example.code:
// End the talk interaction with this NPC
CMND_TALK_END(npcHdl);
